content.title: RAMS FALL TO 13TH-RANKED ILLINOIS IN NCAA TOURNAMENT SECOND ROUND
content.text: NCAA Tournament Second Round Score: Illinois 76, VCU 55 Location: Greenville, S.C. (Bon Secours Wellness Arena Records: VCU 28-8, Illinois 26-8 The short story: Sophomore guard Terrence Hill Jr. pumped in 17 points and grabbed seven rebounds, but VCU's magical 2025-26 season came to an end Saturday night at the hands of third-seeded and 13th-ranked Illinois in Greenville, S.C. OPENING TIP Hill, who erupted for a career-high 34 points in Thursday's win over North Carolina, shot 7-of-16 from the field, including a trio of 3-pointers Senior forward Barry Evans and junior guard Tyrell Ward added 11 points each for the Rams Illinois Andrej Stojakovic led four Illini players in double figures with 21 points THE DIFFERENCE VCU struggled to find its shooting touch all night. The Rams shot 35 percent (23-of-66) from the field overall, including 22 percent (7-of-32) from 3-point range Illinois also owned a 45-29 rebounding advantage and outscored the Rams 17-11 off turnovers The Fighting Illini shot 48 percent (28-of-58) from the field in the game VCU took its only lead of the game at 28-26 on a bucket by Hill at the 3:09 mark of the first half that capped a 15-3 run. But Stojakovic scored the final nine points of the half to give Illinois a 35-28 lead at the break. That run bled into the second half, as UI opened the period with 15-4 blitz that stretched its lead to 50-32 with 13:24 remaining NOTABLE VCU was making the 21st NCAA Tournament appearance in program history The Rams won 28 games in 2025-26, which is tied for the second-most in program history
